rows.label: qst650406_msg0001
rows.name:
Rex! And all you Blade Onee-chans,
thank you!

rows.label: qst650406_msg0005
rows.name:
For a moment, I thought the Ignas
were going to eat us...

rows.label: qst650406_msg0006
rows.name:
When I saw Onee-chan coming to
save us on Unin Island, I realized
we couldn't give up!

rows.label: qst650406_msg0008
rows.name:
So that thing we thought was a total
failure actually meant something.

rows.label: qst650406_msg0009
rows.name: Yeah... Looks like it gave him hope.

rows.label: qst650406_msg0010
rows.name:
All right, let's get moving now.
We have to get the kids home.

rows.label: qst650406_msg0011
rows.name:
Yeah. Let's go back
to Iyasaki Village.
